status: Owner confirmed optional shown/hidden. Concrete settings placement/default and timer controls/clock behavior remain proposals; not implemented.

proposedCommonBehavior.display: selectable shown/hidden is owner-confirmed; see visibility
proposedCommonBehavior.mode: countdown shown; count-up and duration-setting UI undecided
proposedCommonBehavior.themeOrMarkerChange: Preserve timer state and all learning/input state.
proposedCommonBehavior.hide: Preserve timer state; show current state when revealed.
proposedCommonBehavior.finish: Quiet notification only; never submit input, advance sentence, finish practice or write learning history.
proposedCommonBehavior.sound: Optional, respect sound preference; no forced audio.
proposedCommonBehavior.reloadPersistence: Undecided; do not imply implemented cross-reload timing.
proposedCommonBehavior.accurateTiming: Use a shared clock/deadline model, not animation frame counts or per-theme timer engines. Background-tab behavior needs implementation verification.

rendering.pure-white: live text digits on empty LCD body
rendering.natural: live text digits on empty LCD body
rendering.walnut: dynamic remaining-minute/seconds hands over static dial, not time of day; exact text companion available on focus or on demand
rendering.wholeScreenRaster: Reference only. Never a working UI background or state source.

accessibility.keyboard: Native focusable buttons with visible focus and current action labels.
accessibility.remainingTime: Exact text available for all skins including analog; do not rely on dial alone.
accessibility.announcements: Announce user actions and finish, not every second.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Retain exact time; avoid ornamental hand/chain motion.

responsive.narrow: Separate compact control layout needed; do not shrink the full desktop screenshot.

visibility.ownerFeedback: タイマーも表示・非表示を選べるようにしましょう。

setting.label: タイマーを表示
setting.defaultStatus: proposal matching current comp, not an owner-mandated default

visibility.preferencePersistence: Persist independently with device display preferences; do not write learning records.
visibility.layout: Reserve desk area; all pen/book/card/notebook boxes stay unchanged.
visibility.clock: Do not reset or pause simply because hidden; show current clock state on reveal.
visibility.focus: Keep focus on setting; if hiding removes the focused control, return focus to visibility setting. Showing timer must not steal typing focus.
